reason: The threshold table and Gold Gu King EXP behavior are currently supported by repeated community observations, not by a recovered original executable formula/table or original game-data artifact.

direct_level_item_semantic.fact: ItemSpecialType.LevelIncrease = 15, comment: 等级提升一级

script_level_assignment.fact: Command 145 sets target actor level to the average current-actor level plus LevelIncrease; non-integral rounding semantics remain unresolved.

persistent_progression_fields.fact: CombatActorInfo contains Level, Experience, base actor attributes and base element attributes as independent fields.

community_experience_threshold_table.interpretation: minimum cumulative EXP observed/reported for each level
community_experience_threshold_table.cross_check: A separate community answer publishes the incremental sequence; it matches first differences of the cumulative sequence exactly.

gold_gu_king.source_fact_link: Upstream GDB exposes a generic ItemSpecialType.LevelIncrease semantic, but without original game data we cannot prove which item record is 金蛊王.
gold_gu_king.community_claim: 金蛊王 raises level by one without increasing stored EXP.
gold_gu_king.patch_note_evidence: PAL3 v1.2 patch notes state that using a permanent-stat item and then 金蛊王 could revert the permanent increase to the level-defined value, proving that the direct-level path recalculates level-defined stats.

architecture_constraints: Level and Experience must remain independently persisted fields.
Do not derive Level from Experience on load.
Do not normalize Experience when restoring a snapshot.
A direct LevelIncrease path must eventually invoke level-defined stat growth/recalculation; the exact formula is still OPEN.
Combat EXP settlement must remain blocked until party distribution, threshold semantics, and level-growth behavior are evidence-backed.
Command 145 must remain blocked from runtime mutation until its average rounding rule and level-growth side effects are evidence-backed.
open_blockers: Exact original EXP threshold table still lacks binary/original-data corroboration.
Exact per-character level-growth formulas for HP/SP/MP/Attack/Defense/Speed/Luck are unknown.
Command 145 non-integral average rounding rule is unknown.
Gold Gu King item ID is unknown without original GDB or a reliable data dump.
Combat EXP distribution rules and modifiers are not yet authoritative enough for runtime settlement.
